scope: One standard-product DVI acquisition with the mandatory latest title-top executable, followed by restoration of E8. Not a boot-reliability or compatibility estimate.
source_relation: The E6 frozen standard hardware is unchanged in the current product; only examples/rasterix/Breakout.hpp differs. See the existing source audit.

procedure.historical_basis: Boot02 acquired the game after a separate HDMI/DVI720 diagnostic fixture. Boot04 reopened the OBS input for three seconds before standard programming and succeeded; boot05 repeated that procedure and failed. The 2026-11-08 latest-layout trial kept capture active across standard reprogramming and failed.
procedure.hypothesis: Keep the DirectShow input closed across E8-to-standard reconfiguration and Linux boot; acquire only after the latest game has started. Earlier boot04 reopened before programming; boot05 showed that this alone was not reliable.
procedure.difference: The selected OBS input remained deactivated across programming, boot and read-only SD loading; it was enabled two seconds after observing the latest game start banner, then allowed to settle for three seconds before recording.
procedure.additional_trial_decision: No additional repeat: keeping an acquired E8 stream active across standard programming is already represented by the failed 2026-11-08 latest-layout trial. No distinct short recovery procedure was established.
procedure.target_selection: Exact existing JTAG target and xc7a200t_0 checked by the programmer; one selected UART and one visible FPGA capture input. Private identifiers retained outside the repository.
procedure.resource_check: No competing board/UART job or hw_server client found; OBS recording, streaming and virtual camera inactive before the trial; UART opened exclusively.
procedure.capture_method: Existing Windows OBS WebSocket API and selected DirectShow capture input; no foreground UI.

standard.visual_observation: Initial selected image black; later selected image shows Video Format Not Supported. No complete-game frame detected in the full recording.

e8_recovery.visual_observation: Selected fresh recovery image reviewed: WALLY BREAKOUT at the top, SCORE/LIVES and game field visible. This is E8, not standard DVI.

limitations: Signal-acquisition failure cause remains unisolated; this does not establish that standard DVI can never work.
The requested latest-layout standard-DVI demonstration was not obtained.
E6 older-layout footage and E8 HDMI footage are not substitutes for this result.
Original videos, unredacted logs and local configuration are retained privately; no new media is included here.
